description: Eryysara Sorianorides wears a purple floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves and gold woven geometric and floral borders at the neckline, bodice seams, cuffs, central front and hem. Round shoulder clasps, a matching patterned belt with a round medallion buckle, a pendant and finger ring accompany it. A pale ivory wrap with purple-gold borders rests around her forearms. An ivory underdress and closed brown shoes with gold motifs show at the lower opening. Her short wavy bob is uncovered.
